title: Concept: Dependency declared as a tarball URL
description: package.json declares a tarball URL that is fetched directly, outside the registry index, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a tarball URL that is fetched directly, outside the registry index.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a tarball URL that is fetched directly, outside the registry index.
